_comment: Screenshot manifest for docs/screenshots.md and the README.
Each entry records the route, theme, viewport and the demo data it needs, so
the set can be regenerated without guesswork. Capture with:
Themes are switched through the application's own toggle, not injected CSS.

screenshots.name: client-dashboard-light
screenshots.heading: Client dashboard
screenshots.caption: Open a client and see the week ahead: scheduled tickets, maintenance falling due, monitor status, and where their sites are.
screenshots.alt: Client dashboard in light theme with quick actions, record counts, a seven-day schedule, outstanding tasks, monitor status and a site map

screenshots.name: my-work-light
screenshots.heading: My Work
screenshots.caption: Everything waiting on one technician: a running timer with a stop button, open tickets in SLA order, tickets where the customer has replied, the waiting-on-us and waiting-on-customer queues, pending approvals and the week's appointments. Each count matches the list its link opens.
screenshots.alt: My Work page in light theme with a running timer, open tickets sorted by SLA, a customer-replied list, waiting-on-us and waiting-on-customer tabs, pending approvals and upcoming appointments

screenshots.name: global-dashboard-dark
screenshots.heading: Every client at once
screenshots.caption: The MSP-wide view: totals across all tenants, thirty-day health, and a map of every client site.
screenshots.alt: Cross-tenant dashboard in dark theme showing counts for organizations, users, assets, documents and monitors, a thirty-day health summary, and a map of client sites across the United States

screenshots.name: client-overview-light
screenshots.heading: Customer overview
screenshots.caption: Everything about one customer in one place — contacts, sites, and shortcuts into their documentation.
screenshots.alt: Customer overview page in light theme showing company information, primary contact details and two mapped sites

screenshots.name: project-timeline-light
screenshots.heading: Project timeline
screenshots.caption: Drag a bar to reschedule. Dependencies show what is blocked and what it is waiting for.
screenshots.alt: Project timeline in light theme: a Gantt chart of seven tasks with milestones marked, above a dependency table showing blocked tasks and what each waits for

screenshots.name: dispatch-board-dark
screenshots.heading: Dispatch board
screenshots.caption: A week of work per technician. Drag a ticket onto a row to schedule it; the banner flags anything close to breaching.
screenshots.alt: Dispatch board in dark theme showing a week of scheduled work by technician with an SLA-at-risk banner and unassigned tickets

screenshots.name: report-profitability-light
screenshots.heading: Profitability by client
screenshots.caption: Revenue against cost of delivery for the period, drawn from logged time and issued invoices — not typed in.
screenshots.alt: Profitability by client report in light theme showing revenue, cost, margin and blended margin percentage with a per-client breakdown

screenshots.name: report-client-health-dark
screenshots.heading: Client health score
screenshots.caption: A composite of SLA performance, ticket velocity, billing aging and engagement — so at-risk accounts surface before they churn.
screenshots.alt: Client health score report in dark theme ranking five clients by a composite score built from SLA, velocity, aging, engagement and an NPS proxy

screenshots.name: report-hourly-rate-light
screenshots.heading: Effective hourly rate
screenshots.caption: What an hour actually earned once non-billable time is counted, per client and per technician.
screenshots.alt: Effective hourly rate report in light theme showing average, highest, lowest and median rates with billable hours and utilisation per client

screenshots.name: rack-elevation-dark
screenshots.heading: Rack elevation
screenshots.caption: What is in the comms room, at which U, drawing how much power — linked to the asset record for each device.
screenshots.alt: Rack elevation view in dark theme showing a 42U rack populated with a firewall, core switch, patch panel, servers, NAS and UPS at their unit positions

screenshots.name: ipam-subnets-light
screenshots.heading: IP address management
screenshots.caption: Subnets per client with their VLAN, gateway and DNS, and which addresses are allocated, reserved or free.
screenshots.alt: IP address management in light theme listing four subnets with network, VLAN, gateway and location for one client

screenshots.name: scheduling-dark
screenshots.heading: Recurring maintenance
screenshots.caption: Maintenance that recurs on its own schedule, with per-task sign-off, kept separate from the ticket queue.
screenshots.alt: Scheduling page in dark theme showing tasks needing sign-off and upcoming maintenance for the next seven days with priority and status

screenshots.name: monitors-light
screenshots.heading: Uptime and certificate expiry
screenshots.caption: Endpoint checks with response time, and the certificate expiry date you would otherwise find out about at 2am.
screenshots.alt: Website monitor list in light theme showing monitored endpoints with status, response time, SSL expiry date and last check time

screenshots.name: ticket-queue-dark
screenshots.heading: Service desk queue
screenshots.caption: Every client in one queue. Filter by status, priority, queue or technician; the subject is what you scan, not the badges.
screenshots.alt: Service desk queue in dark theme listing twelve tickets across four clients with subject, client, priority, status, queue, assignee and age

screenshots.name: ticket-detail-light
screenshots.heading: A ticket that knows the customer
screenshots.caption: Contract and hours used, the SLA countdown, internal notes kept apart from client replies, the linked asset, and the credentials this job needs — listed, never revealed.
screenshots.alt: Ticket detail in light theme showing the client's active contract, SLA countdown, internal and client-visible activity, the linked asset, vault context with secrets hidden, and logged time

screenshots.name: ticket-composer-dark
screenshots.heading: Internal note composer
screenshots.caption: Public reply and internal note are separate modes. An internal note gets an amber composer that says it is never sent to the client, and an unsent reply is saved as a draft only its author can see.
screenshots.alt: Ticket reply composer in dark theme switched to Internal note, with an amber box labelled staff only and a restored draft

screenshots.name: documents-dark
screenshots.heading: Client documentation
screenshots.caption: Per-client documents and global knowledge base articles, searchable by title and body.
screenshots.alt: Document list in dark theme showing per-client documentation with category, tags and last-updated date

screenshots.name: kb-runbook-light
screenshots.heading: Runbooks beside the work
screenshots.caption: A procedure written for the technician who will actually run it — and linked from the tickets that need it.
screenshots.alt: Knowledge base runbook in light theme with when-to-use guidance, numbered steps and an escalation note

screenshots.name: assets-dark
screenshots.heading: Asset register
screenshots.caption: Every device you look after for a client, filterable by type, manufacturer, status and location.
screenshots.alt: Asset list in dark theme showing devices with name, type, manufacturer, model and serial number, with filters above

screenshots.name: asset-detail-light
screenshots.heading: Asset detail
screenshots.caption: Identity, network, operating system, hardware, rack position, warranty and lifecycle on one record.
screenshots.alt: Asset detail in light theme for a domain controller showing identity, network, operating system, hardware specification, physical position, lifecycle dates and tags

screenshots.name: vault-dark
screenshots.heading: Credential vault
screenshots.caption: AES-GCM encrypted at rest, organised per client. Secrets are never rendered into a list — opening one is a permissioned, audited act.
screenshots.alt: Password vault in dark theme listing nine credentials for one client with title, username and security status, every secret hidden

screenshots.name: quote-detail-light
screenshots.heading: Quote to signature
screenshots.caption: Line items, tax and total, a PDF, and a signing link the customer can use without an account. Accepting it can open a ticket or spin up a project.
screenshots.alt: Quote detail in light theme with line items, subtotal, tax and total, plus actions to view the PDF, email it, copy a signing URL or accept it

screenshots.name: invoice-detail-dark
screenshots.heading: Invoices that explain themselves
screenshots.caption: Every line carries its origin — a contract period, a logged time entry, an expense — so a billing query is answerable without reconstructing it.
screenshots.alt: Invoice detail in dark theme with line items tagged by origin, a payment recording form and a push-to-accounting action

screenshots.name: contract-detail-light
screenshots.heading: Agreements and hours
screenshots.caption: Block hours with rollover rules, auto-renewal, and a profitability snapshot for the current period.
screenshots.alt: Contract detail in light theme showing hours consumed, rollover policy, auto-renewal state and a profitability snapshot

screenshots.name: project-detail-dark
screenshots.heading: Project delivery
screenshots.caption: Tasks, milestones and assignees with budget consumption and profitability rolled up from the work already logged.
screenshots.alt: Project detail in dark theme showing client, owner, dates, a ready-to-bill panel, profitability, budget consumption and a task list with milestones

screenshots.name: quotes-list-light
screenshots.heading: Quote pipeline
screenshots.caption: Draft, sent and accepted quotes across every client, with totals and a one-click PDF.
screenshots.alt: Quote list in light theme showing three quotes across three clients with status, total and creation date

screenshots.name: invoices-list-dark
screenshots.heading: Billing at a glance
screenshots.caption: Sent, paid and overdue invoices with balances, and whether each has been pushed to your accounting system.
screenshots.alt: Invoice list in dark theme showing three invoices with sent, paid and overdue status, totals, balances and accounting push state

screenshots.name: contracts-list-light
screenshots.heading: Agreements per client
screenshots.caption: Which clients are on managed agreements, which are on block hours, and how much of the allowance is gone.
screenshots.alt: Contract list in light theme showing three agreements with type, status, hours used against allowance and period

screenshots.name: organizations-dark
screenshots.heading: Tenants and access
screenshots.caption: Every client is its own tenant. Membership decides who sees what; switching client context is one click.
screenshots.alt: Organization list in dark theme showing client tenants with member counts, asset counts and status

screenshots.name: feature-toggles-light
screenshots.heading: Feature toggles
screenshots.caption: The service desk, AI assistance and other modules are opt-in — off until an administrator turns them on.
screenshots.alt: Feature toggle settings in light theme showing switches for optional modules including the native PSA service desk

screenshots.name: compliance-overview-dark
screenshots.heading: Compliance frameworks per client
screenshots.caption: Which frameworks a client is enrolled in, how far through the attestation they are, and when recertification is next due.
screenshots.alt: Compliance overview in dark theme showing PCI-DSS and HIPAA framework cards for one client with progress bars, status counts and a recertification countdown

screenshots.name: compliance-checklist-light
screenshots.heading: Attestation checklist
screenshots.caption: Per-control status, notes and an evidence link, with who last reviewed it and when — the record you hand an auditor.
screenshots.alt: PCI-DSS attestation checklist in light theme with per-control status dropdowns, notes, evidence links and last-reviewed stamps, colour-coded by compliance state

screenshots.name: readiness-overview-light
screenshots.heading: Documentation readiness
screenshots.caption: Each customer scored against the documentation standards in force, worst first, with a count of unmet requirements.
screenshots.alt: Documentation readiness overview in light theme listing customers with readiness scores and unmet requirement counts

screenshots.name: readiness-customer-dark
screenshots.heading: Readiness for one customer
screenshots.caption: Every requirement in a standard, met or unmet, with a plain explanation of what is missing, why it matters, the records that satisfy it and a link to fix it.
screenshots.alt: Readiness page for one customer in dark theme showing a Microsoft 365 documentation standard with met and unmet requirements and fix buttons

screenshots.name: readiness-repair-light
screenshots.heading: Readiness repair queue
screenshots.caption: Everything unmet across customers in one list, filterable by customer, standard and owner. Excepted items are left out.
screenshots.alt: Readiness repair queue in light theme listing unmet requirements per customer with what is missing, the owner and a fix action

screenshots.name: portal-request-form-light
screenshots.heading: Request a service (customer portal)
screenshots.caption: A customer fills in a guided form from the service catalog. Questions can appear only when relevant (the laptop type appears once "Needs a laptop" is ticked), and the side panel says how long it usually takes and whether approval is needed.
screenshots.alt: Customer portal Employee onboarding request form in light theme with filled-in fields, a conditional laptop type question and a what-to-expect panel

screenshots.name: document-version-diff-dark
screenshots.heading: Document version compare
screenshots.caption: Compare any stored version of a document with the current one, line by line, and restore it if needed. A restore is audited and keeps the replaced content as a version.
screenshots.alt: Document version comparison in dark theme showing removed and added lines between version 1 and the current runbook, with a restore button

screenshots.name: kb-analytics-light
screenshots.heading: KB analytics
screenshots.caption: Most viewed and never viewed articles, articles past their review date with their owner, and searches that found nothing. Only zero-result searches are kept, for 90 days, and vault searches are never recorded.
screenshots.alt: KB analytics page in light theme with most viewed, past review date and never viewed tables and a list of top zero-result searches

screenshots.name: settings-scheduler-dark
screenshots.heading: Scheduler
screenshots.caption: The built-in scheduler's periodic jobs with their interval, last and next run, status and run count. A job that reports a problem shows its error here, such as recurring invoicing skipping a contract that is more than one period behind. Late fees are off until you turn them on.
screenshots.alt: Task scheduler settings in dark theme listing periodic jobs with run history, one failed recurring-invoice job showing its error message, and late fees switched off
screenshots.selector: tr:has-text("more than one billing period behind")

screenshots.name: settings-security-light
screenshots.heading: Security settings
screenshots.caption: Session limits, 2FA, password rules and lockout are set here and take effect when saved. A value fixed by an environment variable is marked "Set by environment" and can only be changed on the server.
screenshots.alt: Security settings page in light theme with session, 2FA, password policy and brute-force fields, two of them marked Set by environment
